english.text: At last he clasped his hands in prayer, and in so doing rubbed the ring, which the magician had forgotten to take from him. jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 laam5 zyu6 soeng1 sau2 kei4 tou2，gam2 joeng2 zou6 zau6 caa4 zo2 go3 mo1 seot6 si1 m4 gei3 dak1 hai2 keoi5 sau2 soeng6 lo2 zau2 ge3 gaai3 zi2。 zik1 hak1 jau5 go3 geoi6 daai6 ji4 ho2 paa3 ge3 zing1 ling4 jau4 dei6 haa6 sing1 hei2，waa6：「nei5 wui5 tung4 ngo5 zou6 di1 me1？ ngo5 hai6 mo1 gaai3 ge3 nou4 dai6，faan4 si6 dou1 wui5 ting1 cung4 nei5。」 aa3 laai1 ding1 mou4 geoi6 gam2 daap3：「gau3 ngo5 ceot1 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1！」 jin4 hau6 dei6 kau4 hoi1 zo2，keoi5 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 hai2 ceot1 min6。
text: 最後佢攬住雙手祈禱，噉樣做就搽咗個魔術師唔記得喺佢手上攞走嘅戒指。 即刻有個巨大而可怕嘅精靈由地下升起，話：「你會同我做啲咩？ 我係魔戒嘅奴隸，凡事都會聽從你。」 阿拉丁無懼噉答：「救我出呢個地方！」 然後地球開咗，佢發現自己喺出面。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: And the seven lean and thin kine that came up after them, and the seven thin ears that were blasted with the burning wind, are seven years of famine to come: Which shall be fulfilled in this order. Behold, there shall come seven years of great plenty in the whole land of Egypt, after which shall follow other seven years of so great scarcity, that all the abundance before shall be forgotten: for the famine shall consume all the land, and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.

text: 而跟住佢哋上嚟嘅七隻瘦瘦哋嘅牛，同埋七隻被燒風吹到嘅瘦耳，就係嚟緊七年嘅饑荒：呢啲要按照呢個順序兌現。睇吓，埃及全地必有七年大富足，之後又將有七年大富足，以致之前所有嘅富足都會被遺忘，因為飢荒必耗盡全地，而富足嘅眾多亦必毀滅埋大富足。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is now Saturday, the 12th of July of 2014. My Chinese neighbours Irene, Fred, and RJ have a garage sale, from which I buy 8 Chinese books, including the translation of George Orwell's 1984. It is really a prize, a treasure about an alternate history of three competing supernations—Oceania, Eurasia, and Eastasia—on Earth. All the books are in the most modern form of logograms, often called "Simplified Chinese" as contrasted with "Traditional Chinese." The family are ground floor tenants of Chinese-Indian Moli and Chinese Leong, both from Fiji. Their house with a big back balcony is next to and north of my home on Lulu Island.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2014 nin4 7 jyut6 12 hou6 sing1 kei4 luk6，ngo5 ge3 zung1 gwok3 leon4 geoi1 Irene 、 Fred tung4 RJ jau5 go3 ce1 fu3 maai6，ngo5 hai2 go2 dou6 maai5 zo2 8 bun2 zung1 man2 syu1，baau1 kut3 zo3 zi6 ou3 wai1 ji5 ge3《1984》ge3 faan1 jik6。ni1 go3 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 zoeng2 ban2，jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 dei6 kau4 soeng6 saam1 go3 ging3 zang1 ciu1 kap1 gwok3 gaa1 —— daai6 joeng2 zau1、au1 aa3 tung4 dung1 aa3 —— ge3 tai3 doi6 lik6 si2 ge3 bou2 zong6。so2 jau5 syu1 dou1 hai6 jung6 saai3 zeoi3 jin6 doi6 ge3 biu1 zi3 jing4 sik1，tung1 soeng4 giu3 zou6「gaan2 tai2 zung1 man2」，tung4「faan4 tai2 zung1 man2」jing4 sing4 zo2 go3 deoi3 bei2。ni1 go3 gaa1 zuk6 hai6 waa4 jeoi6 jan3 dou6 jan4 mok6 lei6 tung4 waa4 jan4 loeng4 ge3 dei6 haa2 zou1 haak3，loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 lai4 zi6 fei2 zai3。keoi5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 jau5 go3 daai6 hau6 joeng4 toi4，hai6 ngo5 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 uk1 kei2 pong4 bin1 tung4 bak1 min6。
text: 而家係2014年7月12號星期六，我嘅中國鄰居 Irene 、 Fred 同 RJ 有個車庫賣，我喺嗰度買咗8本中文書，包括佐治奧威爾嘅《1984》嘅翻譯。呢個真係一個獎品，一個關於地球上三個競爭超級國家 —— 大洋洲、歐亞同東亞 —— 嘅替代歷史嘅寶藏。所有書都係用晒最現代嘅標誌形式，通常叫做「簡體中文」，同「繁體中文」形成咗個對比。呢個家族係華裔印度人莫利同華人梁嘅地下租客，兩個都係嚟自斐濟。佢哋間屋有個大後陽台，係我喺露露島嘅屋企旁邊同北面。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: These orders were not necessary; for in a quarter of an hour's time there grew up all round about the park such a vast number of trees, great and small, bushes and brambles, twining one within another, that neither man nor beast could pass through; so that nothing could be seen but the very top of the towers of the palace; and that, too, only from afar off.

jyutping: ni1 di1 ming6 ling6 kei4 sat6 m4 seoi1 jiu3，jan1 wai6 jat1 hak1 zung1 zi1 hau6，gung1 jyun4 zau1 wai4 zau6 zoeng2 ceot1 gik6 daai6 loeng6 ge3 syu6 muk6，jau5 daai6 jau5 sai3，zung6 jau5 gun3 muk6 tung4 ging1 gik1，wu6 soeng1 cin4 jiu2 gaau1 zik1，mou4 leon6 jan4 ding6 sau3 dou1 cyun1 m4 gwo3；git3 gwo2 ceoi4 zo2 cung4 jyun5 cyu3 min5 koeng5 gin3 dou2 gung1 din6 taap3 lau4 ge3 ding2 dyun1 zi1 ngoi6，mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou3。
text: 呢啲命令其實唔需要，因為一刻鐘之後，公園周圍就長出極大量嘅樹木，有大有細，仲有灌木同荊棘，互相纏繞交織，無論人定獸都穿唔過；結果除咗從遠處勉強見到宮殿塔樓嘅頂端之外，乜都睇唔到。
